historySummary: Mexico and the United States have one of CONCACAF's biggest football rivalries. Based on all-time rivalry records, Mexico leads the series with 38 wins, while the USA has 24 wins and 17 matches ended in draws.

previousMeetings.note: Mexico defeated the United States in the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup final.

notes: All-time record counts can vary by source methodology. This sample uses the 79-match rivalry record as the first verified app data sample.
